pages.title: Reheating
pages.text: $(thing)Reheating$()$(br2)Inflation leaves space empty and cold. When the inflaton reaches the bottom of its potential it oscillates and decays, and its energy becomes a hot plasma of every particle there is: the hot Big Bang begins here. Unlocks Reheating Plasma.

$(thing)Insight$(): 170$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Cosmic Inflation, High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Strange Matter Pellet.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): At the end of inflation the inflaton decays at a rate λ, and its energy turns into a thermal bath of g relativistic species whose energy density is π²gT⁴/30. The decay completes when the expansion rate has fallen to the decay rate, with H² = ρ/(3M_P²). Write the temperature the universe is reheated to.
